Search-index full project introduction: writings on painting circulated in manuscripts and were printed in Italian and French in 1651; original notebooks largely unavailable until early nineteenth century. Direct open unavailable.
Anatomical notes published in late nineteenth century; innovations in illustration, some discoveries and some inaccurate inherited beliefs. No blanket four-century priority for every drawing.
